protocol.selection: COMPLETED images of the study with at least one Tier 3 result that is UNVERIFIED with the reason BASELINE_FAILED or NOT_OBSERVABLE.
protocol.single_run_rule: Each treatment runs on its own with the defensive flags and the mock environment of the study profile, with no baseline run and no gate. It is observed for the window W. A tool without a baseline would report FAIL when the container is not running at the end of W and PASS when it is.
protocol.unit: Images are counted per image: examined images are those for which all four treatments were observed, misblamed images are those with at least one treatment that a single-run tool would call FAIL. Treatment runs are counted in pairs_examined and pairs_single_run_fail.

-e command line argument in order to run eggdrop
for the first time:

NICK   - set IRC nickname
SERVER - set IRC server to connect to

Example:
docker run -ti -e NICK=DockerBot -e SERVER=irc.freenode.net eggdrop

If you wish to telnet or DCC to your bot, you will
need to expose the docker port to your host by
adding -p 3333:3333 (or whatever port eggdrop is
listening on) to your docker run command.

These variables only need to be used the first
time you run the container- after the first use,
you can edit the config file created, directly.
